# Final Review Proposal
**Producer:** agent:codex/gpt-5.4

## Summary

`git diff` on the working tree was empty, so I reviewed the committed gas-exchange implementation directly in `crates/tank_core/src/systems/chemistry.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/systems/dissolved_oxygen.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/water.rs`, `crates/tank_core/src/types/state.rs`, and `crates/tank_core/tests/co2_exchange.rs`. I did not find a task-specific correctness, safety, or robustness issue in the CO2/O2 gas-exchange changes. Targeted validation passed for `cargo test -p tank_core --test chemistry --test dissolved_oxygen --test co2_exchange`. Residual repo-level gap: `cargo test -p tank_core --test validation` still fails in `crates/tank_core/tests/validation.rs::step_hours_leaves_state_untouched_when_clamps_precede_a_validation_error`, but that appears tied to current habitat-registry refresh semantics rather than the reviewed gas-exchange path.

## Amendments

None.
